name: projectsync
description: Keep your MediaMake projects in the cloud: brand kits, productions, release kits and media, shared under each project's permissions.
long_description: Connects Claude to your MediaMake account with a MediaMake API key, and reads and writes files on this computer. Every production (a video's code and outputs), release kit (a YouTube upload pack, a DistroKid release) and media file belongs to one project, and the project's role decides: anyone it is shared with reads, owners and editors upload and change, only the owner deletes. Claude asks you each time whether files go up as a production, a release or media, and to which project. Media is never analysed on the way in.

tools.name: get_brand_kit
tools.description: Read a project's brand kit: colours, fonts, guide and every asset.

tools.name: upload_brand_kit
tools.description: Upload a pack-brand-kit folder from this computer to a project.

tools.name: finish_brand_kit_upload
tools.description: Add brand kit files already PUT to upload links.

tools.name: update_brand_kit
tools.description: Change a project's brand kit fields.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List your MediaMake projects and your role on each.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: One project: your role, its brand kit and how many productions, releases and media it holds.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project (a channel or brand).

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Rename or retag a project.

tools.name: list_productions
tools.description: List a project's productions (videos: code and outputs).

tools.name: get_production
tools.description: One production's files and versions; download them to a folder.

tools.name: create_production
tools.description: Upload a video's code and outputs (and inputs up to 200 MB) to a project.

tools.name: update_production
tools.description: Change a production, or upload a new version of it.

tools.name: delete_production
tools.description: Move a production to the project's trash (owner only).

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List a project's release kits (YouTube packs, DistroKid releases).

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: One release kit's files and versions; download them to a folder.

tools.name: create_release
tools.description: Upload a release kit folder to a project.

tools.name: update_release
tools.description: Change a release kit, or upload a new version of it.

tools.name: delete_release
tools.description: Move a release kit to the project's trash (owner only).

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: List a project's media files.

tools.name: search_media
tools.description: Search a project's media by name or tag.

tools.name: get_media
tools.description: One media file and its link.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Upload single files (pictures, songs, clips) to a project's media, without any analysis.

tools.name: delete_media
tools.description: Move a media file to the project's trash (owner only).

api_key.title: MediaMake API key
api_key.description: From MediaMake → API keys (https://mediamake.microfox.app/core/api-keys). Kept in your system keychain.

api_url.title: MediaMake URL
api_url.description: Leave as it is unless you run your own MediaMake.
